tools.name: roast_landing_page
tools.description: Free AI conversion review of a public landing page URL: score /100, 5-second-test first impression, top 3 problems quoted from the page, and a headline rewrite. Returns a link to the full report page and a roast_id you can pass to buy_full_teardown. Takes ~20s. Limit 5 free roasts per day per IP.

tools.name: buy_full_teardown
tools.description: Quote and buy the $9 full teardown for a roast. Step 1: call with just the roast_id — you get the quote and nothing is charged, no checkout session is created. Step 2: only after the user has said yes, call again with confirmPaymentSpend: true to create the Stripe checkout session and get the URL fo

tools.name: get_full_teardown
tools.description: Read the paid $9 full teardown for a roast, as Markdown. While it is unpaid it returns the free roast and says how to buy it; for the minute after payment it says it is still being written; then it returns the full teardown.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "roast_landing_page" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
